messages:
maya.k: Quick sync: I'm proposing a small, reproducible smoke harness + canary gating flow for FP8/INT8/4-bit profiles so we can ship quantized models with clearer rollback signals.

thomas_r: +1. can you sketch the gates?

maya.k: High level: 1) shadow-run on 2% traffic with deterministic prompt set; 2) golden metrics: EM/ROUGE-ish quality proxies + embedding drift; 3) latency/cost regressions; 4) automatic degrade if quality delta > threshold for N samples.

leo: Are we talking about a per-endpoint gate or per-profile? e.g., FP8 on small models vs 4-bit on large ones.

maya.k: Per-profile but binding at endpoint level. Runtime stores an ordered list: [profileA(fp8), profileB(int8), profileC(fp16)] and canary lives at the head for 2% then cutover gradually.

nina_ops: How do we measure "quality delta" cheaply? Running human evals for canary is impossible.

maya.k: Two parts: (A) fast automatic proxies — token-level logprob drop, ngram-based hallucination heuristics, and embedding distance on a fixed calibration set; (B) fallback to shadow A/B pass-through to unaffected users when proxies trip.

thomas_r: Can you show exact metrics and thresholds? We should avoid lots of false positives.

maya.k: Draft thresholds: embedding cosine drop > 0.05 vs baseline median over 1k prompts = soft alarm; token logprob drop mean > 0.12 = hard alarm; any hallucination heuristic hit rate increase > 2% = hard alarm. These are tunable via rollout windows.

leo: Implementation note: runtime already exposes per-request metadata (model_variant, quant_profile, latency_ms). We can emit a special canary tag so console can surface the canary cohort.

maya.k: Right — add field canary:true and canary_group id. Ops-bot will detect spikes and post alerts.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: Canary flow enabled for endpoint /generate-text with profile fp8-small at 2026-03-21T14:30Z.

nina_ops: For the smoke harness, let's also include a nightly deterministic job that runs the calibration set across all profiles and stores golden vectors for quick diffs.

maya.k: Good call. We'll store vector diffs and a small set of representative nbest outputs to detect structural failures (e.g., missing arguments).

thomas_r: What about the contract between quant profiles and tokenizer/position embeddings? We saw drift when mixing serialization versions. Need a compatibility layer.

maya.k: Agreed. Proposal: profile metadata includes required model-abi (tokenizer hash, kv-serialization-version). Runtime refuses to route a profile if ABI mismatch. Also add a migration mode: allow routing with 'compat-mode' but double-shadow to catch errors.

leo: Ops implication: we need a lightweight reconciler that scans deployments for profile/ABI mismatches and emits a remediation ticket.

nina_ops: I'll add that to the ops backlog. Also suggest we surface a per-customer override: teams can lock an endpoint to legacy profile if they're sensitive to small delta.

maya.k: UX: console button "Enable quant canary" with slider (traffic %) and metrics dashboard (embed drift, token-prob delta, latency, cost delta). Rollback button to revert to previous stable profile.

thomas_r: One more: calibration for rare tokens/formatting can be brittle. Let's ensure our calibration set includes structured prompts (JSON, code, tabular) per customer heavy usage patterns.

maya.k: Yes — we'll support per-tenant calibration sets uploaded as artifacts. Runtime will prefer tenant set when doing canary checks.

leo: Should we add an acceptance test in CI that runs a micro-benchmark with quant hooks? e.g., a small graph measuring perplexity delta on a frozen sample.

maya.k: Absolutely. Add a gated test: quant-smoke in premerge that fails the PR if any profile increases hard-alarm rate beyond baseline on the micro-bench.

nina_ops: Timeline?

maya.k: Prototype harness + console surface in 2 sprints. Canary runtime routing + telemetry in 3 sprints. CI test and per-tenant calibration next sprint after that.

thomas_r: Sounds good. Please open a short RFC doc and I'll review the thresholds.

maya.k: Will do. I'll include example config snippet:

```
canary: {
  enabled: true,
  traffic_pct: 2,
  profile_order: ["fp8-small", "int8-medium", "fp16"],
  metrics: {
    embed_cosine_threshold: 0.05,
    token_logprob_threshold: 0.12,
    hallucination_rate_threshold: 0.02
  }
}
```

leo: Nice. @nina_ops can you file the ops ticket for reconciler?

nina_ops: On it. filing now :white_check_mark:

maya.k: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the RFC link once it's up. :rocket:
